SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_paid_member = 1 AND valid_order_count >= 1 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN is_paid_member = 1 THEN valid_order_count ELSE 0 END) AS monthly_paid_order_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN is_paid_member = 1 THEN net_sales_cents ELSE 0 END) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
FROM "data"."main"."member_monthly_summary" member_monthly_summary_model_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', month_start) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
